hooks.command: if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ODOO_URL" ] && { [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ODOO_API_KEY" ] || [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ODOO_PASSWORD" ]; }; then echo 'odoo-tools (MCP): plugin options configured'; elif [ -f "$HOME/.claude/tools/odoo-cli/dist/cli.js" ]; then echo 'odoo-tools (CLI fallback): ready'; else echo 'odoo-tools: NOT CONFIGURED - run /odoo-tools:odoo-setup-mcp (or odoo-setup-cli)'; fi
